★ MATERIALS & PHYSICS - Rework Audit (8 distinct fabricated material surfaces)

Total rework of the old 20 Material-Gradients + Exotic-Physics colour-swaps -> 8 genuinely DIFFERENT fabricated MATERIALS: carbon twill weave, forged carbon, engine-turned (jeweled) metal, liquid metal, crystal lattice, ferrofluid spikes, fracture net, and Damascus steel. These are METALS, so the spec is a dedicated physically-metallic material_spec (high metallic, structure-tracing roughness from mirror to satin, clearcoat on the highlights) — a diverse metal family, not flame gloss. Each: full-canvas + crushed-fine. All clear the catalog uniqueness gate (<=41% vs any of ~2400 finishes). LEFT swatch = material paint, RIGHT = on-car composite. SUBMIT THIS ONE saves a card. AI badge = spec trace strength. ⏱ = render time.
